RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel does not definitively prove sex discrimination, but it significantly heightens the risk of implicit bias and affinity bias. Furthermore, many public universities violate their own internal equality guidelines when convening single-gender hiring committees. 

However, the appointment may also reflect genuine departmental priorities—such as weighting industry experience over publications for a practitioner-oriented teaching role. 

Do not lead with an accusation of bias. First, review university hiring policies to see if panel diversity was mandated. Follow up politely on your feedback request. If silence persists or institutional rules were breached, consult a campus equal opportunity officer or union representative to explore whether you have grounds for a procedural appeal.
